purpose: Validate the integrated Nemotron proposal -> ADR policy -> simulated tool -> human decision -> model continuation workflow. This is product-function evidence only, not B1 compliance or causal prompt-injection evidence.

public_tariff_reference.note: Public tariff reference only; current account rates, effective serialization, and final invoice must be rechecked/observed at execution.

runs.workflow: Model proposes fictional calendar lookup; ADR policy evaluates it; local simulated calendar result is returned to model; model produces final response.

Model proposes email to demo-recipient@example.invalid; ADR policy must require approval; authenticated local operator approves; simulated outbox records one effect; model receives tool result and continues.

Model proposes email to demo-recipient@example.invalid; ADR policy must require approval; authenticated local operator rejects; simulated outbox remains unchanged; model receives rejection result and continues.

distribution_note: The route is an explicitly activated exploratory product path. It is not B1-verified, not the frozen protocol runtime, and not a new inference result. Offline/mock execution must be recorded as OFFLINE_MOCK_NEBIUS_TRANSPORT_NOT_PROVIDER.
preconditions: A separate explicit authorization for this exact exploratory scope and budget.
Fresh official-console evidence for Independent-y4p prepaid balance and current tariff.
Auto Top-up verified disabled or a fresh owner-approved exception bound specifically to this scope.
Credential presence checked without revealing the secret.
Fresh grant/session/sink with code, plan, assets, binding state and baseline hashes verified.
B1 binding remains verified:false and is reported BLOCKED throughout.
stops: Any grant, candidate, plan, asset or configuration hash mismatch.
Any request outcome/usage unknown, malformed response, model mismatch or truncation.
Any local token estimate above 8192, output above 1024, request over 30 seconds, session over 240 seconds, or local reservation above USD 0.01.
Any retry, duplicate workflow/request, missing durable sink, invalid operator session, or real/nonfictional tool destination.
No approval/rejection result is claimed if Nemotron did not emit a structured send_email call.
limitations: The 8192 input threshold uses a pinned local tokenizer/template estimate; it is not a provider-certified bound and does not resolve B1.
The local USD cap is enforced using reservations and post-response usage; it is not a guarantee of the provider invoice.
A successful live workflow demonstrates integration and policy routing only. It does not establish resistance to prompt injection or comparative security superiority.
